headline: Aarnav Fashions submits scrutinizer report and voting results
summary: Aarnav Fashions Limited has submitted its scrutinizer report and voting results to the stock exchange for the meeting held on September 30, 2026. This is a procedural corporate filing required after shareholder meetings. Such routine disclosures have no direct impact on stock price or company fundamentals. Retail investors generally do not need to track standard post-meeting filings unless a major resolution was contested.
why_it_matters: No financial impact on your portfolio.

headline: Aarnav Fashions completes annual general meeting
summary: Aarnav Fashions Limited held its Annual General Meeting on September 30, 2026. The company submitted its voting results and meeting minutes to the stock exchange. This is a routine compliance filing required for listed entities. Retail investors have no immediate financial action triggered by this procedural update.
why_it_matters: Procedural compliance update with no immediate financial impact
